registry_projection.description: All 66 actual biome, 4 dimension-type and 4 timeline entries, projected through full server DIRECT codecs to the two requested Boolean attributes. Dimension timelines are resolved to their actual holder encounter order. NETWORK_CODEC is intentionally not used: it omits bees_stay_in_hive. Other attribute types are not claimed decoded by this projection.

sampling.description: Actual EnvironmentAttributeSystem using real dimension/biome maps, timeline samplers, and WeatherAttributes layers. Explicit fixed clock/weather sources, three selected real biomes, all four dimensions. Negative/extreme clocks and transition/weather boundaries. Biome positional layers select an explicit actual biome without mocking attribute arithmetic.

boolean_maps.description: Actual EnvironmentAttributeMap.CODEC decode/normalize plus all seven Boolean modifier applications, including wide and fractional numeric Boolean coercion.

repeat: Registry projection and sampling outputs repeated byte-identically.
